dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Here's your new ATM card, and this is your PIN.
dialogue.reading: hɪrz jʊr ˈnuː ˌeɪ tiː ˈɛm ˌkɑːrd, ənd ˈðɪs ɪz jʊr ˈpɪn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thank you. Could I change my PIN?
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː. kʊd aɪ ˈtʃeɪndʒ maɪ ˈpɪn?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes, you can change it at the ATM.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, juː kən ˈtʃeɪndʒ ɪt ət ði ˌeɪ tiː ˈɛm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Can I withdraw money at any ATM?
dialogue.reading: kən aɪ wɪðˈdrɔː ˈmʌni ət ˈɛni ˌeɪ tiː ˈɛm?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes, but it's only free at our ATMs.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, bʌt ɪts ˈoʊnli ˈfriː ət aʊər ˌeɪ tiː ˈɛmz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. Could I check my balance now?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. kʊd aɪ ˈtʃɛk maɪ ˈbæləns ˈnaʊ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Sure. Your balance is two thousand baht.
dialogue.reading: ˈʃʊr. jʊr ˈbæləns ɪz ˈtuː ˈθaʊzənd ˈbɑːt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Great. Thank you for your help!
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt. ˈθæŋk juː fər jʊr ˈhɛlp!
